name: NEGATIVE_CLAIM_REQUIRES_CLOSED_SEARCH_UNIVERSE

relation_to_prior_connection.refinement: HIDDEN-006 targets a narrower negative-evidence failure: NOT_FOUND_IN_S is not OBJECT_ABSENT unless S is an admitted search universe with appropriate coverage for the object/claim.

source_grounded_instances.interpretation: Failure to find an exact James placed reference in reviewed public-derived sources cannot be promoted to absence from the actual ESM; the real-plugin exhaustive export remains the successor gate.
Unmatched identifiers are retained as unresolved/excluded rather than assigned a negative or positive identity claim outside the verified bridge coverage.
Lower-level public/script/count evidence cannot settle exact placed-asset lineage; unresolved exact lineage is preserved until the authoritative ESM reference chain is inspected.

Missing evidence for an exact compromise boundary does not justify selecting a precise safe boundary; uncertainty expands rather than becoming a false negative claim about compromise outside the observed subset.

proposed_operator.admission_rule: Promote NOT_FOUND_WITHIN_S to an absence statement only inside the scope for which search coverage and detection sensitivity are explicitly admitted. Never silently widen a scoped non-detection into global absence.

why_a_human_may_miss_it: The same failure mode appears under unrelated vocabulary—public-derived game sources versus real ESM, unmatched epigraphic identifiers, unresolved asset lineage, and uncertain compromise horizons. The shared object is not the topic but the topology of a negative inference across an incomplete observation boundary.

falsification_plan.heldout_selection: Select records with explicit searches/enumerations but exclude all four formulation sources and Connection-family records before inspection.
falsification_plan.support: A held-out source preserves scoped NOT_FOUND/UNKNOWN because coverage is incomplete, or requires exhaustive/authoritative coverage before absence promotion.
falsification_plan.contradiction: A held-out source explicitly establishes a global absence claim from a declared incomplete/non-authoritative search without an additional premise that closes the universe.
falsification_plan.not_applicable: The source has no search-universe/non-detection relation.
falsification_plan.destructive_control: Hold observed non-detection fixed while toggle/rewire the coverage-completeness field; an admissible absence verdict should change only when the coverage gate changes.

next_gate: Freeze a structure-only held-out search-universe panel and preregister SUPPORT/CONTRADICTION/NOT_APPLICABLE semantics before source inspection; then test the coverage-toggle destructive control.
